# Saved Search Plan

## Context
Users want to save a search query and rerun it.

## Decisions
Saved searches belong to the user. Max 50 per user. Stored in src/saved-search.ts.

## Contracts
saveSearch(userId, query) returns the saved record. listSearches(userId) returns newest-first. Deleting a search is idempotent.

## Tasks
1. Add the saved-search store in src/saved-search.ts.
2. Wire save/list/delete into the search view.
